enriched_description: Medium-large hunting dog with a short, dense coat in solid liver or liver-and-white combinations. Coat is fine and sleek with a distinctive ticking or roan pattern in patched varieties. Body is athletic and well-muscled with a slightly sloping topline and deep chest. Head is clean-cut with a broad skull and long, square muzzle. Ears are moderately long, set high, and hang close to the head. Tail is docked and carried horizontally. Eyes are medium-sized, brown, with an intelligent, eager expression. Built for endurance and speed with webbed feet for swimming. The breed's versatile pointing stance is characteristic, with one front paw raised and body frozen in alert position.

Medium-large pointer with a distinctive rich, deep red (rust-golden) short coat that is smooth, dense, and close-lying. Coat color ranges from golden rust to dark russet red with no other markings. Body is lean, muscular, and well-proportioned with a slightly arched loin and deep chest. Head is noble and refined with a broad skull and long, square muzzle. Ears are thin, pendant, and set moderately low. Tail is docked to approximately one-quarter length and carried level. Eyes are medium-sized, brown, harmonizing with coat color. The breed's signature feature is its uniform golden-rust coloration and elegant, athletic build resembling the Weimaraner but with distinctly red coat.

Medium-large sporting dog with a long, silky, flat coat that is predominantly white with colored markings (blue belton, orange belton, tricolor, or lemon belton). Coat features distinctive feathering on ears, chest, belly, legs, and tail. Body is elegant and well-proportioned with a slightly sloping topline and deep chest. Head is long and lean with a flat skull and well-defined stop. Ears are low-set, pendant, and covered with long, silky hair. Tail is medium-length, straight or slightly curved, with long flag-like feathering. Eyes are medium-sized, oval, and dark brown with a soft, gentle expression. The breed's characteristic gait is smooth, effortless, and ground-covering.

Large sporting dog with a distinctive chestnut-brown to mahogany-red coat that is long, silky, and flat-lying. Coat is moderate in length on the body with abundant feathering on ears, chest, back of legs, and tail. Body is elegant, well-balanced, and athletic with a slightly sloping topline. Head is long and lean with a slightly domed skull and long, square muzzle. Ears are set back, low, pendant, and covered with long, silky hair. Tail is carried level with the back, moderately long, and well-feathered with a flag-like appearance. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and dark hazel to brown with a keen, intelligent expression. The rich, uniform red coloration is the breed's most distinctive feature.

Large, heavy-boned setter with a distinctive black-and-tan coat. Coat is soft and glossy on the body with moderate feathering on ears, chest, belly, back of legs, and tail. Tan markings appear above eyes, on sides of muzzle, chest, legs, and under tail. Body is substantial and well-muscled with a level topline and deep chest. Head is clean-cut with a broad skull and square muzzle. Ears are low-set, pendant, and covered with long hair. Tail is short, thick at the base, and carried level or slightly below. Eyes are medium-sized, dark brown, and oval with an alert, intelligent expression. The black-and-tan coloration and heavier build distinguish this breed from other setters.

Medium-tall, compact bird dog with a smooth, dense coat in orange-and-white or liver-and-white patterns. Coat is moderately long on the body with minimal feathering compared to other spaniels. Body is well-balanced and athletic with a short-coupled frame and deep chest. Head is clean-cut with a round skull and medium-length muzzle. Ears are moderately long, pendant, and set high. Tail is naturally short or docked, carried high. Eyes are medium-sized, amber to dark brown, with an alert, intelligent expression. The breed's distinctive feature is its tall, leggy build for a spaniel and smooth coat with minimal feathering, giving it a more pointer-like appearance.

Thickset, heavy-boned spaniel with a long, silky, predominantly white coat with lemon or orange markings. Coat is abundant, straight, and weather-resistant with feathering on chest, legs, and belly. Body is long, low, and substantial with a massive head and heavy bone structure. Head is broad and square with a pronounced occiput and deep flews. Ears are large, grape-leaf shaped, and set at eye level. Eyes are dark amber, medium-sized, and deep-set with a solemn expression. Tail is docked, carried level, and well-feathered. The breed's distinctive features include its low-slung, heavy build, massive head, and solemn, dignified expression.

Medium-sized spaniel with a medium-length coat in black-and-white or liver-and-white patterns. Coat is flat or slightly wavy with abundant feathering on chest, legs, belly, and ears. Body is compact, well-proportioned, and slightly longer than tall with a level topline. Head is clean-cut with a medium-length muzzle and moderate stop. Ears are long, broad, lobular, and set at eye level. Tail is docked and carried level, well-feathered. Eyes are medium-sized, almond-shaped, and hazel to dark brown with a gentle, pleading expression. The breed's characteristic gait is smooth and effortless with good reach and drive.

Medium-sized spaniel slightly smaller than the English springer, with a distinctive rich red-and-white coat. Coat is silky, straight, and weather-resistant with moderate feathering on chest, legs, and belly. Body is compact, well-balanced, and slightly longer than tall. Head is clean-cut with a slightly domed skull and medium-length muzzle. Ears are pendant, lobular, and set at eye level, smaller than the English springer. Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering. Eyes are medium-sized, brown, and almond-shaped with a gentle expression. The red-and-white coloration is the breed's most distinctive feature, setting it apart from other springer spaniels.

Small, compact spaniel with a long, wavy, silky coat in various solid colors (black, red, golden, liver) or parti-color patterns. Coat is abundant with heavy feathering on chest, legs, belly, and ears. Body is sturdy and well-balanced with a slightly sloping topline. Head is well-proportioned with a rounded skull and square muzzle. Ears are long, lobular, set low, and heavily feathered. Tail is docked and carried level with moderate feathering. Eyes are large, round, and dark brown with a soft, pleading expression. The breed's distinctive features include its merry tail action, long feathered ears, and gentle, expressive eyes.
